WhatWillLearn.title: What Your Child <accent>Will Learn</accent>
WhatWillLearn.subtitle: Fun, interactive lessons that teach kids how to save, spend, and grow money with confidence.

features.title: Smart Saving
features.description: Helps children understand the value of money, patience, and the importance of saving for future needs and goals.

features.title: Budgeting Basics
features.description: Teaches kids how to manage their allowance, track expenses, and make smart budgeting decisions early on.

features.title: Investing 101
features.description: Introduces how money can grow over time through simple investing concepts and compound interest.

features.title: Earning Money
features.description: Encourages entrepreneurial thinking by showing kids how effort, skills, and creativity create value.

features.title: Smart Spending
features.description: Guides children to distinguish between needs and wants and make thoughtful, responsible spending choices.

features.title: Goal Setting
features.description: Helps kids plan and work toward short-term and long-term financial goals with confidence and clarity.

AgeGroupProgram.title: Curriculum Designed for <accent>Every Stage</accent>
AgeGroupProgram.subtitle: We've tailored our lessons to match your child's developmental milestones, ensuring learning sticks at every age.

programs.title: Money Basics for Little Learners
programs.description: Fun, story-based lessons that introduce kids to needs vs wants, simple saving goals, and positive money habits in a playful way.
programs.details: Story-led missions, needs vs wants sorting, three-jar saving, and mini parent prompts you can do in under 10 minutes.

programs.title: Smart Money Explorers
programs.description: Introduces budgeting, earning allowance, and saving challenges, helping kids make smarter money decisions early on.
programs.details: Budgeting games, allowance planners, saving challenges, first bank vocabulary, and quick parent tips to keep habits consistent.

programs.title: Teen Wealth Builders
programs.description: Covers budgeting & banking, investing basics, and entrepreneurial thinking to prepare teens for real-world financial independence.
programs.details: Practice budgets, mock debit/credit scenarios, beginner investing with simulations, and small business exercises with feedback.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked <accent>Questions</accent>
FAQ.subtitle: Answers to help you feel confident about your child's learning journey with Zaza Academy.

items.question: What if my child misses a class?
items.answer: All live classes are recorded and added to your dashboard within 24 hours. Your child can watch the replay anytime and complete the activities at their own pace.

items.question: Do parents need to attend?
items.answer: For ages 5-7, we suggest parents stay nearby for the first sessions. For 8+, the program is built for independent learning, and parents are always welcome to observe.

items.question: What ages can enroll?
items.answer: We offer tailored programs for three age groups: 5-7 (Money Basics), 8-11 (Smart Money Explorers), and 12-16 (Teen Wealth Builders).

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and Apple Pay. Choose between quarterly or annual billing to suit your family.

items.question: Is it available in English and French?
items.answer: Yes. Zaza Academy is fully bilingual. You can choose your preferred language for lessons and materials in your account settings.

Footer.tagline: Empowering the next generation with essential financial skills through fun, engaging, and age-appropriate education.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: ZAZA Academy respects your family's privacy and is committed to protecting personal information.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content:
We may collect:
• Parent or guardian name and email address
• Child's first name and age group
• Payment information (processed securely by third-party providers)

sections.title: 2. Children's Privacy
sections.content:
We do not knowingly collect unnecessary personal data from children.
We comply with applicable children's privacy laws, including COPPA.

sections.title: 3. How We Use Information
sections.content:
Information is used only for:
• Program enrollment and delivery
• Communication with parents
• Providing class updates and materials

sections.title: 4. Data Protection
sections.content: We do not sell, rent, or share personal information with third parties.

sections.title: 5. Data Removal
sections.content: Parents may request access to or deletion of personal data by contacting us at: zazaacademy@gmail.com

TermsAndConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsAndConditions.intro: Welcome to ZAZA Academy. By enrolling a child in any ZAZA Academy program, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

sections.title: 1. Program Description
sections.content: ZAZA Academy provides online financial education programs designed for children ages 5 to 16. Our programs include live online classes, recorded replays, worksheets, and educational materials.

sections.title: 2. Enrollment & Access
sections.content:
Enrollment grants access only for the duration of the selected program.
Access to class recordings and materials is limited to enrolled families.
Materials may not be shared, copied, resold, or distributed without written permission from ZAZA Academy.

sections.title: 3. Parental Responsibility
sections.content: Parents or legal guardians are responsible for supervising their child's participation and ensuring a safe learning environment during online sessions.

sections.title: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All content, materials, lessons, worksheets, and branding are the property of ZAZA Academy and are protected by copyright laws.

sections.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: ZAZA Academy provides educational content only and is not responsible for individual financial outcomes or decisions made by families.

sections.title: 6. Changes to Services
sections.content: ZAZA Academy reserves the right to update program content, schedules, instructors, or materials as needed.

sections.title: 7. Parent Consent & Child Participation Agreement
sections.content:
By enrolling my child in ZAZA Academy, I confirm that:
• I am the legal parent or guardian of the enrolled child.
• I give permission for my child to participate in online learning sessions.
• I understand sessions may be recorded for educational and replay purposes.
• I agree that my child will participate respectfully and appropriately.
• I acknowledge that ZAZA Academy provides educational content, not financial advice.

sections.title: 8. Code of Conduct
sections.content:
ZAZA Academy is committed to providing a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment.

Expectations for students and parents:
• Be respectful to instructors and fellow students
• Use appropriate language and behavior
• Follow instructor guidance
• Do not disrupt learning sessions
• Do not share inappropriate or offensive content

ZAZA Academy reserves the right to remove any participant who violates this code of conduct, without refund.

sections.title: 9. Educational Disclaimer
sections.content: ZAZA Academy provides financial education for learning purposes only. We do not offer financial, legal, or investment advice. Parents and guardians remain fully responsible for financial decisions made within their households.

RefundPolicy.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
RefundPolicy.intro: At ZAZA Academy, we value fairness and transparency.

sections.title: 1. Refund Eligibility
sections.content:
Full refunds are available up to 7 days before the program start date.
No refunds will be issued once the program has started.

sections.title: 2. Missed Classes
sections.content: Missed classes are not refundable. Replays will be made available whenever possible.

sections.title: 3. Program Cancellation
sections.content: If ZAZA Academy cancels a cohort for any reason, a credit will be issued for the following cohort.
